metadata.name: portfolio_nav
metadata.description: Permissionless on-chain portfolio NAV crank (M6 / ADR-0008)

instructions.name: accept_vault_role
docs: Incoming-program consent for vault oracle role (B.7 step 4).
Ops: `stoken::propose_roles(oracle → nav_authority)` is a human
governance batch; this ix only claims. Do not run live rotations here.

instructions.name: close_nav_scratch
docs: Governance or the crank payer closes a leftover `nav_scratch` PDA.

instructions.name: close_pool_feed
docs: Close a pool feed PDA and return rent to governance. The factory `Pool`
must already be Halted — closing a live feed would un-mark a still-traded
pool.

instructions.name: crank_nav_page
docs: Permissionless paged NAV crank. Page 0 inits scratch; last page writes.

accounts.name: custodian
docs: The portfolio vault's custodian — the allocator PDA recorded as
`vault_config.asset_manager`. Bound here so a permissionless caller
cannot pass a custodian they control and have the crank value
attacker-owned zero-balance accounts as portfolio custody. The per-leg
and USDC custody accounts are additionally pinned to this custodian's
canonical ATAs in `nav_scratch::handler`.

accounts.name: position_page
docs: Factory-owned page. PDA is checked against `nav_config.factory_program`.

instructions.name: crank_pool
docs: Permissionless pool crank: Pyth × escrow balances, then `stoken::update_price`
as `nav_authority`. Inside cooldown: no CPI (`CrankPoolNoop` / `CrankPoolHeldCooldown`).

accounts.name: pool
docs: Factory `Pool` (owner = the pinned factory, `composable_portfolios_state::ID`).
Binds this crank to the vault/mint the feed-map seed actually belongs to
— not an unbound pubkey.

accounts.name: vault_config
docs: Heap-allocated. `VaultConfig` is about 1KB; on the stack it pushes
`CrankPool::try_accounts` past the 4KB sBPF frame, and the custody
constraints then compare spilled bytes.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: — rec2 by default (SDK Owner is rec5), or the governance-set adapter.

instructions.name: crank_pool_external
docs: H-5 Layer C. Reads `external_assets_usd` from the adapter feed derived
from `pool` (posted through `put_price_guarded`), adds escrow USDC,
applies Layer B / A′, CPIs `update_price` as `nav_authority`.
Ops: `propose_roles(oracle → nav_authority)` on ETH vaults is a human
governance batch. Do not run live rotations from this program.

accounts.name: vault_config
docs: Same heap move as `CrankPool`: this accounts struct also holds `VaultConfig`.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: Owner must be `nav_config.expected_price_owner()` (the adapter after
`set_price_source`). Posted through `put_price_guarded` so Layer A applies.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates `NavConfig` and the system-owned `nav_authority` PDA.

instructions.name: propose_adapter_feed_max_age
docs: Propose a new adapter-feed max age. Accept after `ADAPTER_FEED_POLICY_DELAY_SECS`.

instructions.name: set_pool_feed
docs: Create or replace the Pyth feed ids for `pool`. Signer must be `NavConfig.governance`.
`kamino_vault` default (zero) is Jupiter. A catalogue vault pubkey marks
Kamino so `crank_pool` fail-closes without that remaining account.

instructions.name: set_price_source
docs: Point every PriceUpdate owner check at `new_source`. Passing rec2
explicitly goes back to the real receiver; the default pubkey is
refused (default-in-state already means rec2). `price_source_program`
must be the named program and executable — a typo'd or non-program
source would brick every crank. Reallocs a pre-upgrade config to the
current length, rent topped up by governance.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Pays the realloc rent top-up when the live account is short.

accounts.name: price_source_program
docs: or non-program source would brick every crank.

fields.name: turnover_pending_underlying
docs: Completed rebalance sales not yet settled, in underlying units.

fields.name: turnover_fee_period_start
docs: Start of the current turnover-fee cap window.

fields.name: turnover_fee_charged_in_period
docs: Turnover fee already charged in the current window, in underlying units.

types.name: NavConfig
docs: Account traits are hand-implemented instead of `#[account]` so a shorter
append-only body (no trailing `price_source`) still deserializes. Fresh
accounts are `8 + INIT_SPACE`. Discriminator, owner, and serialize match
the macro.

fields.name: governance
docs: Copied at `initialize`; `set_pool_feed` / `close_pool_feed` require this signer.

fields.name: price_source
docs: Program expected to own every PriceUpdate account. Default = rec2
(`PYTH_RECEIVER_PROGRAM_ID`); `set_price_source` writes an explicit one.

fields.name: adapter_feed_max_age_secs
docs: 0 = `DEFAULT_ADAPTER_FEED_MAX_AGE_SECS` (300). Official Pyth pull stays 60.

fields.name: payer
docs: Crank payer; `close_nav_scratch` may refund here.

types.name: PageLeg
docs: One held pool on a `PositionPage`.
`weight_bps == 0` means exiting (in the manifest, not in current targets).

types.name: PendingCooldowns
docs: Pending cooldown changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingFees
docs: Pending fee changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingLimits
docs: Pending limits changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingPrice
docs: Pending price update waiting for approval

types.name: PendingRoles
docs: Pending roles change waiting for per-role incoming-holder claims

types.name: PendingTargets
docs: Header-only pending change. The set lives on `PendingTargetsAccount`.

fields.name: turnover_underlying
docs: `expected_out` of a sale this book chose. Zero for redemption and halt exits.
Counted into `turnover_pending_underlying` only when the request closes.

types.name: PendingWhitelist
docs: Pending whitelist changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingWithdrawalParams
docs: Pending withdrawal parameter changes waiting for approval

fields.name: redemption_estimate_secs
docs: Conservative estimate. Propose notice is at least this long.
Capped at 30 days at registration (`MAX_NOTICE_SECS`).

fields.name: risk_tier
docs: Disclosed input, not a guarantee.

fields.name: max_execution_loss_bps
docs: Atomic min-out bound; an async breach halts or quarantines the pool.

fields.name: pool_reserve_ratio_bps
docs: Published reserve target; keeper-enforced and monitored.

fields.name: risk_disclosure_hash
docs: Canonical JSON factors/assumptions served by the API.

fields.name: kamino_vault
docs: Catalogue Kamino vault. Default = not Kamino (Jupiter 1.0-share path).

fields.name: kamino_underlying_decimals
docs: Underlying mint decimals for the converted Kamino amount. 0 = unused
(Jupiter path uses the custody mint's decimals).

types.name: Portfolio
docs: Portfolio header. Targets and positions live on `PositionPage` PDAs.
Task 5 breaking resize: no in-account targets/positions vecs.
Account traits are hand-implemented so a shorter append-only body (live
cluster before `book_seq`, or any later suffix) still deserializes.
Fresh accounts are `8 + INIT_SPACE` and take the full path. Discriminator,
owner, and serialize match `#[account]`.

fields.name: pending_targets
docs: Timestamps only. The proposed set is `PendingTargetsAccount`.

fields.name: deprecated_rebalance_delay_secs
docs: Unused. Bytes stay so existing portfolio headers still decode.
Notice is resolved from `FactoryConfig` and `AccessRecord` at propose.

fields.name: book_seq
docs: Bumped on apply finalize and `retire_position`. NAV pages snapshot this
so a book mutation mid-crank cannot publish a mixed-page mark.

types.name: PositionPage
docs: One page of the position manifest.
Seeds: `["portfolio_page", portfolio, page_index.to_le_bytes()]`.

types.name: RoleKind
docs: Vault role kind for per-role claim (`accept_role_assignment`)

types.name: VaultConfig
docs: The main vault state that manages user deposits, withdrawals, and management fees.
This struct represents an S-Token vault that:
- Accepts deposits in an underlying token
- Issues shares representing vault ownership
- Manages fees and profit distribution
- Enforces access controls and limits

fields.name: pending_price
docs: Pending price update awaiting approval

fields.name: max_deviation_bps
docs: Maximum allowed price deviation in basis points before manual approval required

fields.name: last_price_update_timestamp
docs: Last price update timestamp for deviation cooldown

fields.name: price_update_cooldown_secs
docs: Cooldown period between price updates for deviation checking

fields.name: price_acceptance_cooldown_secs
docs: Cooldown period in seconds after which anyone can accept pending price

fields.name: next_withdrawal_id
docs: Storage for withdrawal sequence counter

fields.name: downside_cap_bps
docs: Withdrawal lifecycle parameters
Maximum negative slippage bot may absorb (in basis points)

fields.name: withdrawal_ttl_secs
docs: Time-to-live after which request can be cancelled fee-free (in seconds)

fields.name: system_penalty_bps
docs: Extra shares minted to user when cancel happens after TTL (in basis points)

fields.name: pending_withdrawal_params
docs: Pending withdrawal parameter changes awaiting approval

fields.name: paused
docs: Vault pause state

fields.name: emergency_withdrawal_timelock_end
docs: Emergency withdrawal timelock end timestamp

fields.name: emergency_withdrawal_cooldown_secs
docs: Emergency withdrawal cooldown period in seconds (default 24 hours)

fields.name: emergency_withdrawal_token_mint
docs: Pending emergency withdrawal request token mint (None if no active request)

fields.name: emergency_withdrawal_amount
docs: Pending emergency withdrawal request amount (0 if no active request)

fields.name: role_change_cooldown_secs
docs: Role change cooldown period in seconds (default 48 hours)

fields.name: config_cooldown_secs
docs: Default cooldown period for configuration changes in seconds

fields.name: pending_roles
docs: Pending roles change awaiting approval

fields.name: fee_change_cooldown_secs
docs: Fee change cooldown period in seconds (default 24 hours)

fields.name: pending_fees
docs: Pending fee changes awaiting approval

fields.name: pending_limits
docs: Pending limits changes awaiting approval

fields.name: pending_whitelist
docs: Pending whitelist changes awaiting approval

fields.name: pending_cooldowns
docs: Pending cooldown changes awaiting approval

fields.name: deposit_whitelist_enabled
docs: Deposit whitelist enabled flag

fields.name: withdrawal_whitelist_enabled
docs: Withdrawal whitelist enabled flag

fields.name: schema_version
docs: Schema version for explicit account migrations.

fields.name: paused_at
docs: Fee accrual cutoff recorded when emergency pause begins.

fields.name: max_price_staleness_secs
docs: Maximum age of a price used by priced user operations.

fields.name: migrating_asset_manager
docs: Previous asset manager allowed only to return funds during migration.

fields.name: is_sunset
docs: Permanent deposit/inbound-swap shutdown flag.

fields.name: pending_sunset
docs: Timelocked pending sunset transition.
